description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the AttrEval-Simulation, comparing the proportions of different sources. The chart is divided into six slices, representing ENTITYQUEST (blue, 26.0%), HOTPOTQA (red, 24.2%), POPQA (yellow, 21.6%), TRIVIAQA (orange, 22.7%), TREC (green, 1.9%), and an unlabeled category (gray, 3.6%). The percentage labels are displayed outside the chart, adjacent to their corresponding slices, and are connected by lines. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, starting from ENTITYQUEST, with no slices visually emphasized or offset. The chart does not include a legend, relying on the labels and colors to distinguish between categories.
